summary.going_well: Three of six simulations passed, showing the agent can complete the tested flow when it launches and remains connected.
summary.to_improve: The primary issue is launch reliability: two of the three failures occurred before a conversation could be evaluated. Separately, investigate why one identity-verification and booking flow ended mid-process, with telemetry that distinguishes agent termination, user disconnect, and test timeout.

issues.description: Two simulations failed before any usable conversation: one agent never joined within 30 seconds, and another was not ready within 10 seconds and may have crashed during startup. No transcript was available to identify an in-dialogue cause.
issues.suggestion: Add startup health checks, structured boot logs, dependency validation, and automatic restart/retry; do not advertise readiness until the agent can join a room.
issues.label: Startup reliability

issues.description: In one simulation, the agent began collecting identity information but the session ended before verification, confirmation, or booking completion. This was observed once, and no transcript was available to determine whether the agent or harness ended the interaction.
issues.suggestion: Instrument disconnect ownership and each booking stage, then add resumable state and concise guided prompts so interrupted identity-verification flows can continue without restarting.
issues.label: Flow completion
